hypothesis: Native TTT writes on unknown-outcome action-query tokens pollute its fast state. Causal interleaved query->confirmed observation input with dense prequential consequence supervision plus mask to write ONLY on confirmed observation tokens should improve 16D held-final unseen-action and post-change late prequential effect errors over same model/inputs/loss with unguarded writes, and over confirmed-only final-loss supervised hybrid; all must face strongest P86-calibrated online 256-float conventional fixed learner.

source.generator: P86 pure SHA256-derived integer/dyadic rank4 causal action-effect map with independent P88 seed namespace. 48 executed historical interventions (action16, observed effect16); hidden rank4 map switches after event24 in 50% worlds; plus previously unseen final action49 and its withheld effect. Data Tensor shapes action/effects [N,49,16], change [N]. Paired input 97 tokens: [action0,zeros unknown effect], [action0, observed effect0], ... [action47,0],[action47,effect47],[action48,0]. Pair labels [effect0..effect48], supervised ONLY on query tokens 2*t with t>=16 and NO fact-token losses. Effect_t is introduced to stream strictly at later token 2*t+1. Original model source unchanged.
source.source_bytes: Must be byte-identical across Ubuntu and Windows; assert SHA of FIT and VAL generated source on exact candidate commit, all effects dyadic, query effect zero, each new query unique under cosine abs<.999, regime counts exactly half. No prior P65–P87 consumed cohort reuse. OOD/NEG protected source constructors reject use.
source.no_leak: At query index 2*t, mutation of the subsequent confirmation token 2*t+1 MUST NOT affect its prediction. At t+1 prediction, modifying the earlier confirmed effect MAY have influence; verify causality negative control. No oracle cause regime or current effect input.
